context: Manages camera height and transitions between local, regional and national views.
description: Adjusts field of view, altitude and movement speed based on zoom level and notifies the tile streamer to update loaded tiles.

classes.name: CameraController
classes.description: Handles zoom logic and user input for camera control.

methods.name: SetZoomLevel(level)
methods.description: Change current zoom level to local (0), regional (1) or national (2).
methods.pseudocode: currentLevel = level; adjust camera height and FOV accordingly; notify tile streamer.

methods.name: Update(input)
methods.description: Process user input each frame and update camera position and zoom.
methods.pseudocode: Read scroll wheel or key input; if zoom changed: call SetZoomLevel(); update position with pan controls.

pseudocode: Listen to input; adjust camera height and FOV; instruct tile streamer to reload tiles when zoom changes.
